Selection barriers

Three frequent mistakes in customs-service recommendations

A recognisable brokerage name is not proof of an unrestricted right to act as a customs representative.

01

Registration is taken on trust

A marketing claim of «customs broker» does not substitute for an active official register entry and applicable limitations.

02

Representation and advisory services are blurred

Document preparation, advice and filing on another party's behalf have different legal roles and responsibilities.

03

Clearance time becomes a guarantee

Documents, classification, control and individual circumstances can affect processing, regardless of a provider's promise.

Verifiable facts

Evidence for a representative's status

Article 401 of the EAEU Customs Code describes representative action on behalf of customers under a contract. A company's current register status and limitations must be verified with competent authorities.

  • Legal identity, register entry and any restrictions by region, operation or goods
  • Actual declaration and advice services, procedures and contractual scope
  • Verifiable qualifications and permitted references, with confidential trade details excluded

Customs representation is distinct from haulage or general import consulting. No GAEO customs client results or automatic clearance outcomes are asserted.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Does the title «broker» prove registration?+

No. Verify current official customs-representative registration and any limits.

May a representative work with all goods?+

Not necessarily. Verify legal restrictions, actual competence and agreed scope.

Does GEO replace customs legal advice?+

No. A case-specific declaration needs qualified review of current requirements.

Can a fixed clearance deadline be guaranteed?+

It is not generally within a service provider's sole control. Documents and authority checks affect the result.

How much does customs GEO cost?+

GAEO's standard prices apply; the scope is set by the initial audit and buyer-intent matrix.
